title: Associate Consultant, Arabic or Russian speaker
summary: Early-careers Associate Consultant in Dubai: research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, modelling, proposals, client meetings across strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy. Start early 2027. Arabic or Russian fluency mandatory.
qualifications_required: Graduated by early 2027 from a top tier university, any degree
Fluent English and fluent Russian or Arabic
Enjoys working with numbers; quantitative data-driven business
jd_text:
We are Analysys Mason, the award-winning specialist management consultancy for technology-intensive industries. We help clients make high stakes technology decisions with confidence, and we turn those decisions into action.
Our sector expertise includes telecoms, digital infrastructure, software, IT services, space, defence, manufacturing and logistics.
Since 1985 we have grown to 400+ professionals across 17 offices in 13 countries, and our experts have delivered work in more than 140 countries. We built our reputation on deep analytical insight and advanced economic modelling.
Over more than four decades, Analysys Mason has evolved into a trusted adviser to businesses, investors and governments worldwide. Our experts deliver high-impact results and transformative change across our clients’ most critical strategic, regulatory, technology, transaction and transformation initiatives.
Our vision is to be the leading authority and catalyst for digital change, connectivity and inclusion. We help businesses, governments and investors use technology to create a world that is more connected, competitive, sustainable and secure.

Our early careers opportunities have a strong record of establishing early career foundations and developing well-rounded industry skills in our Associate Consultants.
You will work on a diverse mix of international projects with the best-known brands in the industry, applying our deep domain expertise and methodology to solve complex business issues.
You will attend our comprehensive training programme where you will learn essential consulting skills and industry knowledge through courses, networking and teamwork.
After completing the training, you will join project teams and provide strategic advice and high-quality analysis on all aspects of strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy while continuing your professional development.
Because our project teams are small, you will regularly get direct exposure to our world-class experts, not only in your office, but also across our global locations. You will receive hands-on mentoring from experienced members of the team, including our Partners.
Our culture is collaborative and team-oriented, and you will have an impact on project delivery from an early stage, which will provide a steep learning curve and a structured career progression.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
conducting high-quality research
offering quantitative and qualitative analysis of that research
gathering and interpreting numerical data
modelling and forecasting using various pieces of software
presenting your main findings in written, graphical and live form
contributing to proposal creation and client meetings
collaborating with other teams across our global locations
developing deep sector knowledge
and more.

If you are a problem-solver who is critical and analytical in your approach, then this is the right job for you.
The role is set to start in early 2027, so you must have graduated by early 2027, and you must have a degree from any academic background (including STEM, Humanities and others) from a top tier university.
You must enjoy working with numbers as we are a quantitative data-driven business.
As long as you are keen to learn about the sector, you do not need to have an industry background. As a matter of fact, many of our consultants only became experts after joining us.
You must be fluent in English and in either Russian or Arabic.

On top of an exciting opportunity, we offer many attractive benefits, including:
annual bonus
25 days of annual leave
employer pension contribution
enhanced maternity leave
enhanced family leave (paternity, adoption, shared, etc)
private health and dental care
mental wellbeing app
flexible working
your birthday off
stepped career progression
continuous training for professional and personal development
career coaching programmes
volunteering days
Cycle-to-work scheme.
We are proud to be an equal-opportunities employer and ensure fair work practices for all our employees, clients, candidates and other associated persons.

title: Consultant Strategy & Transaction Private Equity (m/f/d)
summary: Consultant, Strategy & Transaction (private equity) in Frankfurt or Munich: commercial due diligence, growth and GTM strategy, cost optimisation, portfolio strategy and M&A. German and English both required; 3+ years at Tier 1/2 or boutique.
qualifications_required: Graduate of a top university or business school
3+ years at Tier 1 or Tier 2/boutique firms
Demonstrable exit readiness, cost optimisation, due diligence or PMI project experience
Excellent German and English
jd_text:
We are Analysys Mason – an award-leading global management consulting firm helping clients to make and act on the decisions that steer their progress and connect our world. 
Specialising in technology, media, telecoms and space, we provide bespoke strategy, transaction, transformation and regulation and policy consulting, combined with research and insights. We help clients navigate complex transformation journeys, always shaping the next. 
Since 1985, our team has expanded to 450+ professionals across 17 offices in 13 countries and our experts have taken on work in over 140 countries, making us a truly global company. 
Our vision is to be the leading authority and catalyst for digital change, connectivity and inclusion. We are committed to a sustainable, connected future – contributing to a world where technology delivers for all. 
Our expertise spans commercial due diligence, strategic value creation, digital transformation and industrial tech – with a strong sector focus on B2B tech-enabled services, software, tech, mobility and digital health. 
We offer the opportunity to take up this position in Munich, Frankfurt, or London.

YOUR TASKS
As a Consultant Strategy & Transaction, you will advise private-equity backed companies and major corporates on high-impact initiatives, ranging from cost reduction and operational improvements to portfolio optimisation and buy-and-build strategies. You will leverage in-depth market insights, robust financial modelling, and strong stakeholder management to deliver clear, data-driven recommendations to senior leadership teams, while being based in Munich or Frankfurt.
Look forward to diverse and challenging tasks, such as: 
Commercial Due Diligence: Participation in transactions, including the creation of commercial evaluations, factbooks and information memoranda 
Growth Strategy Development: Support and co-development of growth and Go-To-Market strategies 
Cost Optimization & Operational Excellence: Identify cost drivers, propose reduction measures, design new business models, and recommend process improvements that enhance efficiency and profitability 
Portfolio Strategy & M&A: Provide guidance on buy-and-build initiatives, portfolio restructuring, and post-merger integration to unlock synergies and scale effectively 
Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and financial evaluations to support critical strategic decisions 
Executive Stakeholder Management: Prepare concise, board-level materials and work closely with senior executives and investors to ensure alignment on the most critical strategic objectives 
Cross-functional Collaboration: Engage with finance, operations, and other teams to ensure seamless project execution and maximum value capture

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
Graduate of a top university or business school with an outstanding academic record
3+ years of experience at Tier 1 or Tier 2/boutique firms
You have very good skills in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).
You have affinity for software and IT-services topics (e.g., Managed Services, SaaS, etc.).
You have demonstrable experience in exit readiness, cost optimisation, due diligence, or post-merger integration projects.
You have the ability to assimilate industry insights quickly and translate them into tangible recommendations.
You have proven ability to build relationships at senior levels and influence decision-making with clear, concise presentations.
Excellent language skills in German and English

YOUR BENEFITS
Collaboration on pioneering projects in the field of digitalisation and buy-and-build.
A collegial, ambitious corporate culture with room for personal and professional development. 
Regular employee development discussions and opportunities to contribute 
Personalised training and career development opportunities 
Individual support and international career prospects through collaboration with experts from the Analysys Mason network. 
Regular team events, such as team breakfasts, a summer festival and a Christmas party. 
Modern, centrally located office. 
Competitive industry salaries, including a bonus programme. 
Ready to shape the future with us? Become part of a team where your ambition meets endless opportunities. Discover what makes Analysys Mason unique and let’s create impact together – your next big career step starts with us. 
Shape the next! 
We look forward to getting to know you and exploring how YOUR story could help write our next chapter! 
We look forward to meeting you and listening to your ideas!

title: Consultant – Strategy & Growth Advisory, ICT
summary: Consultant, Strategy & Growth Advisory (ICT) in Singapore: lead client engagements, business development with revenue ownership, thought leadership, mentoring juniors. Title/level set after interviews. 5-7 yrs.
qualifications_required: Bachelor's in business, economics, engineering, technology or similar
5-7 years in consulting, advisory, market intelligence or strategy
Foundational ICT industry understanding
Experience managing complex projects and senior stakeholders
jd_text:
About the Role
Turn insights into impact. Shape strategy. Drive growth.
At Frost & Sullivan, we help businesses navigate disruption, unlock growth opportunities and turn ambitious strategies into measurable business outcomes.
As a Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact client engagements, managing multiple projects concurrently and leading complex assignments involving senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams of 4–5 or more resources.
Beyond project delivery, you will build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers, translate market intelligence into actionable growth strategies, and identify opportunities to expand client relationships and generate new business. You will take ownership of selected accounts, including revenue targets, while contributing to business development, thought leadership and the growth of our advisory practice.
This is an opportunity for a commercially minded consultant who enjoys solving complex business challenges, influencing executive decisions, developing new client relationships and mentoring the next generation of consulting talent.
(The final level and position title will be determined based on the outcomes of interviews and assessments)
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Consulting & Project Leadership
Lead multiple client engagements from problem definition and research through analysis, strategic recommendations and implementation roadmaps.
Develop robust analytical frameworks, methodologies and compelling storylines that translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Ensure the quality, commercial relevance and timely delivery of client outcomes.
Apply Frost & Sullivan’s Growth Pipeline Engine (GPE) framework to help clients identify, prioritise and accelerate growth opportunities.
Facilitate Growth Pipeline Dialogs and contribute to the continuous improvement of consulting tools, frameworks and delivery approaches.
2. Business Development & Revenue Growth
Proactively identify, develop and convert new business opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts.
Build relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers to uncover business challenges, understand growth priorities and position relevant consulting solutions.
Lead business development discussions, contribute to proposals and presentations, and articulate the value of Frost & Sullivan’s advisory offerings.
Take ownership of selected client accounts and revenue quotas, driving account expansion, repeat business and long-term client value.
Collaborate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions, cross-selling opportunities and new avenues for revenue generation.
3. Executive Engagement & Thought Leadership
Establish credibility as a trusted business advisor to senior client stakeholders, influencing strategic discussions and decision-making.
Deliver impactful executive briefings, client workshops, keynote presentations, webinars and industry conference sessions.
Translate complex research and market intelligence into clear, persuasive narratives that resonate with senior audiences.
Represent Frost & Sullivan’s insights, proprietary frameworks and Growth Pipeline methodologies in client and industry forums.
Contribute thought leadership content, industry perspectives and practice-specific initiatives that strengthen our market positioning.
4. Client Relationship & Engagement Management
Build and nurture strong relationships across client organisations, from project teams to senior management.
Facilitate challenging discussions, align stakeholders and build consensus around strategic priorities and recommendations.
Manage project portfolios, resources, timelines, budgets and client expectations while maintaining high delivery standards.
Anticipate project risks, address emerging issues and communicate solutions effectively.
Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and translate successful engagements into longer-term partnerships.
5. Practice Development & Team Leadership
Mentor and coach junior consultants, strengthening their analytical, consulting, presentation and client-management capabilities.
Develop specialist expertise in 2–3 functional or industry-related skill areas and serve as an internal subject-matter resource.
Collaborate with marketing and practice leadership on thought leadership, new offerings and Growth Pipeline Advisory (GPAD/GPaaS) initiatives.
Contribute to the development of new consulting solutions, commercial propositions and approaches that enhance client value and practice revenue.
Represent the practice at industry events, client forums and paid speaking engagements where appropriate.
Required Competencies
Education & Experience
A relevant bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, technology or a related discipline. A master's degree or PhD is an advantage.
Typically, 5–7 years of experience in consulting, advisory, market intelligence, strategy or a related professional services environment.
A foundational understanding of the ICT industry, including its structure, operating models, competitive landscape and emerging trends.
Experience managing complex projects, engaging senior stakeholders and delivering high-quality client outcomes.
Exposure to business development, consultative selling, account management or revenue-generating activities is highly desirable.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking
Strong research, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to develop evidence-based recommendations.
Ability to connect data, market trends and business implications into a coherent, compelling story.
Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, structured and persuasive reports in professional English.
Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of how consulting solutions create measurable business value.
Business Development & Client Influence
Confidence in initiating conversations, building professional networks and developing lasting client relationships.
Ability to identify client needs, qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions and contribute to winning new business.
Strong presentation, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to defend recommendations with confidence and professionalism.
Willingness to represent Frost & Sullivan through executive presentations, public speaking, webinars and industry engagements.
Personal Effectiveness & Leadership
Self-driven, entrepreneurial and comfortable taking ownership with minimal supervision.
Well-organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
Collaborative, adaptable and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
Able to mentor colleagues, share knowledge and contribute to a high-performance team culture.
Disciplined in maintaining analytical rigour, professional integrity and consistently high-quality standards.
About the Practice Area
Information & Communications Technologies (ICT) 
ICT Advisory powers clients to a future shaped by growth by helping them create lasting value for their customers in local and global markets. Our end-to-end advisory proposition covers the entire spectrum from tactical to strategic and from product-orientated to ecosystem-orientated goals.
We commit to specific outcomes and deliver tangible benefits to clients that we articulate: Speed and relevance, optimal alignment with customer markets and ecosystems, independence and credibility, risk mitigation and accuracy, resilience and long-term sustainability, cost effectiveness.
Our clients are enterprise software vendors, infrastructure vendors, service providers, outsourcers, solution providers, device manufacturers, government and standards agencies and end-user organizations that deploy digital technology, based all over the world.
What will make you succeed at Frost & Sullivan?..
You need to be- 
Wildly curious and entrepreneurial
Committed to customer success
A self-starter invested in your future
A persuasive communicator
Deeply Analytical
Excited about Disruptive Trends
Benefits
A friendly work environment with an ‘open door’ policy
A strong career path with growth opportunities.
Be part of a global team that strives for excellence, and fosters an Olympic spirit
Feed your intellectual curiosity by collaborating across all levels of the company across the globe
Global Recognition - President’s Club & Chairman’s Club Awards
Continuous learning and coaching
Flexible work policy
About Frost & Sullivan
Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 65 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero. Learn more about Frost & Sullivan at www.frost.com

Fresh graduate or up to six months relevant experience

jd_text:
Associate, Growth Advisory 
Frost & Sullivan’s Practice Areas help clients understand market dynamics, identify growth opportunities and navigate business challenges through research, market intelligence and strategic advisory. 
About the Role 
The Associate is an entry-level position offering hands-on experience in Growth Advisory. The role provides a strong learning curve while contributing to research, analysis, client deliverables and business growth initiatives across industries. 
Responsibilities
Research & Analysis: Conduct research, analyse data, identify trends and develop actionable insights.
Project Delivery: Support research, analysis and client deliverables while meeting quality standards and deadlines.
Client Support: Assist with proposals, presentations and business development through research and content development.
Collaboration: Work effectively with team members, incorporate feedback and seek guidance when needed.
Professional Development: Build industry knowledge and strengthen research, analytical and consulting skills.
Required Qualifications & Competencies
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Engineering, Technology or a related field; postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
Experience: Fresh graduates or candidates with up to six months of relevant experience.
Research & Writing: Ability to conduct research, synthesise information and write clearly in English.
Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret data, identify trends and draw logical conclusions.
Business Acumen: Interest in industry trends, market dynamics and business challenges.

jd_text:
Position: Associate, Embedded at Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Location: New Delhi
Business Unit: Foundations Advisory
About Sattva
We
Partner
to deliver social impact at scale
Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.
Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: 
www.sattva.co.in
About the Team
The Foundations team collaborates with a network of global philanthropic foundations, alongside multilateral aid agencies, aiming to inform, influence, and profoundly impact social and environmental outcomes resulting from their investments in diverse sectors such as education, child development, gender, health, and more. Our primary focus is on catalysing ecosystem transformation by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound, effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged while their interests are covered.
The Opportunity
As an Associate in the Foundations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact.
In this role, you will be embedded within the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship for twelve months. The following will be your key responsibilities:
Key responsibilities:
Problem Solving
Understands the problem deeply and asks the right questions in teams discussions.
Identifies key data and information through primary and secondary research and builds strategic narratives for communicating data and research insights with the key message.
Entrepreneurial, bringing high bias for execution and client focus; asks relevant stakeholders for help when required.
Delivery Excellence
Collaborates effectively with internal and external stakeholders (including government stakeholders) and manages relevant resources in order to deliver on one's work.
Ensures that they plan ahead and work smart to achieve all their deliverables.
Tracks overall project progress and is able to flag when things are not on track.
Ensure creation and adoption of high-quality assets, methods, and standards created during delivery.
Stakeholder Engagement
Establishes a deep rapport with the middle management of the client organization through constant engagement and personal credibility.
Listens actively to clients and understands both articulated and unarticulated needs.
Presents own point of view convincingly using relevant information, arguments, and examples.
Project Management
Plans day to day responsibilities effectively at an individual level.
Possesses excellent time management and prioritization skills to work on key activities that are directly linked to impact outcomes.
Proactively monitors and reports any risk in individual/project milestones.
Maintains thorough documentation of key project knowledge assets.
Give and receive constructive feedback to the team members in a respectable manner.
Skills Required
At Sattva, our goal is realizing the impact on the ground and to drive a collective win by engaging with multiple stakeholders. We are looking for individuals who align with our mission of alleviating poverty in our lifetime and have the following profile:
2-4 years of experience in problem-solving and stakeholder management in consulting firms or government bodies.
Prior embedded Government experience: a placement, secondment, fellowship or strategy-unit role inside a Ministry, a State Government or a Government body. Experience with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship is highly desirable.
Demonstrated ability to work with Government officials and navigate inter-ministerial decision-making.
Exceptional problem-solving and advisory skills, strong presentation and data analytical abilities.
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas effectively.
Ability to organize own work and manage own time with minimal supervision.
Why Sattva?
It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design.
Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment.
Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can.
Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow.
How to Prepare?
This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.
